2607.15861.title: Conditional Reliability of Toxicity Signals for Multilingual and Code-Mixed Abuse Detection
2607.15861.paper_summary: Moderation systems increasingly rely on external toxicity tools, but those tools are unreliable under code-mixing, transliteration, slang, and language mismatch. We study the \emph{conditional reliability} of toxicity priors in Indian multilingual and code-mixed short text: English toxicity, Indic abuse, and rule-based severity cues can be useful evidence, but only in some linguistic and abuse-severity contexts. We propose ToxGate, a trust-fusion head that conditions each auxiliary signal on the encoder representation before adding it to the prediction state. Across three short-text abuse datasets, four transformer encoders, and five seeds per setting, ToxGate improves over matched plain encoders in 10 of 12 in-domain settings and 7 of 8 transfer settings. The largest and most interpretable gains occur in high-risk moderation slices, including explicit slurs, violent threats, and cross-dataset transfer. The broader lesson is that moderation systems should treat external toxicity tools and priors as conditional evidence rather than fixed features or ground truth, in focused ablations, source-specific gating gives the strongest results in transfer, severe-abuse slices, and high-risk triage.
2607.15861.paper_summary_zh: 越來越多的內容審核系統依賴外部毒性工具，但這些工具在代碼混合、音譯、俚語和語言不匹配的情況下並不可靠。 我們研究印度多語言和代碼混合短文本中毒性先驗的\emph{條件可靠性}：英語毒性、印度語言的辱罵以及基於規則的嚴重性提示可以作為有用的證據，但僅在某些語言和辱罵嚴重性上下文中有效。 我們提出了ToxGate，一種信任融合頭，該頭在將每個輔助信號添加到預測狀態之前，根據編碼器表示進行條件化。 在三個短文本辱罵數據集、四個Transformer編碼器和每個設置五個種子中，ToxGate在12個領域內設置中有10個超過了匹配的普通編碼器，在8個轉移設置中有7個超過了它們。 最大且最具可解釋性的增益發生在高風險的審核片段中，包括明確的侮辱、暴力威脅和跨數據集轉移。 更廣泛的教訓是，內容審核系統應將外部毒性工具和先驗視為條件證據，而不是固定特徵或真實基礎，在專注的消融中，源特定的門控在轉移、嚴重辱罵片段和高風險分診中給出了最強的結果。
